config.scope: Bounded synthetic one-dimensional native transport qualification; no hydraulic, industrial, learned-model or volume-approval claim.
config.declaration: Follow-up declared after the baseline 32/64/128-cell scheduled-inlet refinement failed its unchanged order gate. Only that regime's meshes are refined; no numerical method, forcing, CFL, or acceptance threshold is relaxed. The original baseline config and failed evidence are retained.
notes: Mean-L1, RMS and maximum field errors have units mg/L; signed ledger errors have units mg.
Spatial studies compare native, continuum and independently computed semidiscrete fields; low-CFL time contamination is bounded separately.
Temporal studies use fixed meshes and independently computed semidiscrete references.
Scheduled inlet fields can have fronts; only mean-L1 refinement is gated, with no smooth Linfinity convergence claim.
Mixed semidiscrete eigendecomposition is a checked floating-point numerical oracle, not an exact enclosure.
Output times constrain Euler substeps; schedule studies hold their declared output grid fixed.
All configured source profiles and forcing data are finite and nonnegative.

Baseline evidence out/a9/qualification/report.json records scheduled-inlet orders 0.2765063820 and 0.2037015797. The follow-up studies the same narrow-front forcing on 128/256/512 cells; coarse scheduled-inlet accuracy remains unqualified.

limitations: The scheduled-inlet front study refines mesh and time together at fixed CFL; it has no semidiscrete time-error separation.
Passing mean-L1 gates does not qualify local peak or maximum-norm accuracy for a nonsmooth inlet front.
Mixed-ADR eigendecomposition uncertainty is a conditioning-based floating-point estimate, not a formal enclosure.
Only the declared synthetic cases and mesh ranges are qualified; coarse scheduled-inlet baseline convergence remains failed.

rejections.message: Transport substep/cell-update budget exhausted; refine the request or use another scheme.
Transport output exceeds four million concentration values.
